# agents.PromptVersion

<!-- Generated by `pnpm contracts:catalog`. Do not edit. -->

An immutable version of an agent prompt (platform instructions or a tenant addendum).

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `agents.PromptVersion` |
| Kind | `entity` |
| PII | `personal` |
| Tenancy scope | `platform` |
| Permission | `core.prompt.read` |

## Fields

| Field | Required | PII | Description | UI |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `agentId` | yes | `none` | Agent the prompt belongs to. |  |
| `body` | yes | `personal` | Prompt text; may mention people or internal policies. |  |
| `bodySha256` | yes | `none` | SHA-256 hex of the body. |  |
| `createdAt` | yes | `none` | When the version was written (UTC). |  |
| `createdBy` | yes | `personal` | Author. |  |
| `evalExperimentId` | yes | `none` | Experiment that evaluated this version. |  |
| `evalVerdict` | yes | `none` | Verdict of that experiment. |  |
| `id` | yes | `none` | uuidv7 of the version. |  |
| `note` | yes | `personal` | Author's note about the change. |  |
| `scope` | yes | `none` | `platform` or `tenant`. |  |
| `tenantId` | yes | `none` | Organization of a tenant addendum; null for platform scope. |  |
| `version` | yes | `none` | 1-based version number per agent, scope and tenant. |  |

## Relations

_None._
